statusDefinitions.READY: The authored/source input is available for internal assembly; final film or release approval is not implied.

statusDefinitions.REJECTED: A rejected candidate must not be used as the selected shot asset.

readinessDefinitions.generationReady: All 15 company and AX shots have selected available frames/sources, prompts and constraints, continuous timing, valid film slots, and no SOURCE_PENDING or REJECTED shots. This means pre-generation review is complete and production generation may begin; it does not mean a finished film exists.
readinessDefinitions.releaseReady: Whether final generated/edited films have passed public-source, rights, privacy, factual, playback, and publication review. This remains false.
readinessDefinitions.productionReady: Release/production completion only: final motion generation and editing, final export wiring, public approvals, deployment, and production-route verification. This remains false until the post-generation gates are complete.
